terra.problem: “A Deaf Man Hears”: Mark 7:31–37 places Jesus in the region of the Decapolis after His journey to the Sea of Galilee, but it does not say the healing happened at the sea itself.
“Jesus Appears at Dawn”: John 21:1–7 says Jesus stood on the shore while the disciples were in the boat; it does not yet say they met Him on the shore. Say that Jesus appeared to them from the shore.
